newsitem.title: USA: Frontier Insurance prices $150 mln offer.
newsitem.headline: Frontier Insurance prices $150 mln offer.

text.p: Frontier Insurance Group Inc said on Wednesday that it has priced $150 million convertible trust originated preferred securities of Frontier Financing Trust at $50 a share.

The convertible shares have a dividend rate of 6-1/4 percent and are convertible into 1.066 shares of Frontier's common stock, equivalent to a conversion price of $46.89 per share of Frontier Common Stock, Frontier said. The transaction is expected to close on October 16, 1996, the company said.
Proceeds will be used to repay bank debt, contribute capital to its insurance businesses and for general corporate purposes, Frontier said.
